Conditional LMs model the distribution of a text y given a conditioning input x. This type of model is used for translation where (x, y) pairs are sentences in the source and target language or summarization where (x, y) pairs are corresponding articles and summaries.
One often reports perplexity, the exponentiated negative average log likelihood per token.
